# Collateral and Credit Risk Assessment Update

This document details critical updates and monitoring requirements for collateral and credit risk management.

## Key Actions Required:

*   Update the collateral value for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Optimize the borrower credit score standard update process.
*   Review the collateral value quarterly.
*   Investigate the default risk quarterly.
